business_summary: Showa Shinku Co., Ltd. produces and sells vacuum equipment and components for quartz devices, optical thin films, and electronic devices in Japan, China, Taiwan, and internationally. It operates through Vacuum Technology Application Equipment Business and Service Business segments. The company offers vacuum deposition equipment; arc-discharge-type ion plating equipment; sputtering equipment; atomic layer deposition equipment; etching equipment, such as single wafer and batch type RIE equipment; ashing equipment, including plasma cleaning equipment; wafer trimming equipment; lord lock and in-line type ion beam frequency adjustment equipment; in-line type and high vacuum annealing equipment; film thickness control systems comprising optical film thickness control systems, and wireless temperature and crystal monitors; vacuum equipment for the aerospace industry; vacuum metallurgical equipment for dissolution, heat treatment, sintering, and degassing; multi-color and monochrome optical monitor for thin films; and IAD cold cathode ion source. It also provides SEARCHROID, an image recognition system; EPIoT, an edge computing system for predictive maintenance; hall accelerated ion source/plasma bridge neutralizer; high power RF ion source; ion source for etching; high usage efficiency cathode; and power saving device for oil diffusion pumps. In addition, the company offers modification and repair work. Its products are used in smartphone, automobile, digital camera, endoscope, tablet PC, and light-emitting diode applications. The company serves optical and electronics component industries. The company was formerly known as Showa Shinku Kikai (Showa Vacuum Machinery) Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Showa Shinku Co., Ltd. in 1978. Showa Shinku Co., Ltd. was founded in 1953 and is headquartered in Sagamihara, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Showa Shinku Co., Ltd.는 일본, 중국, 대만 및 해외에서 석영 장치, 광학 박막 및 전자 장치용 진공 장비 및 부품을 생산 및 판매합니다. 진공 기술 응용 장비 사업과 서비스 사업 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 진공 증착 장비를 제공합니다. 아크 방전형 이온 도금 장비; 스퍼터링 장비; 원자층 증착 장비; 싱글 웨이퍼, 배치형 RIE 장비 등의 에칭 장비; 플라즈마 세척 장비를 포함한 애싱 장비; 웨이퍼 트리밍 장비; 로드락 및 인라인형 이온빔 주파수 조정 장비; 인라인형 및 고진공 어닐링 장비; 광학 필름 두께 제어 시스템, 무선 온도 및 크리스탈 모니터로 구성된 필름 두께 제어 시스템; 항공우주산업용 진공 장비; 용해, 열처리, 소결 및 탈기를 위한 진공 야금 장비; 박막용 다색 및 흑백 광학 모니터; 및 IAD 냉음극 이온 소스. 또한 이미지 인식 시스템인 SEARCHROID를 제공합니다. 예측 유지보수를 위한 엣지 컴퓨팅 시스템인 EPIoT; 홀 가속 이온 소스
